remaining_limits: Golisopod Bug Bite contact spacing still needs a target-oriented pass.
Regieleki arm strands and Necrozma windup can obscure the source; no complete mesh-clearance certification.
Mimikyu dedicated Shadow Ball retains its existing star decoration after launch.
No live NPC or wild encounter was played; battle-kind comparisons use the offline stage.
Generic mouth aliases are deliberate surface alternatives where the model has no visible oral cavity.
Existing geometry blockers and missing limb/anatomical routes remain tracked separately.
scope: 30 exact forms, existing individually reviewed points. 37 representative effects visually inspected in offline actual-stage previews, using native action clocks. Recipe families share configured beam timing; dedicated presenters retain explicit move exceptions. Does not approve every move, contact distance, target size or live battle environment.

brambleghast.review: Front twig below the eyes. Rejected emission during the spin; charge starts at .67 and beam launches at .70 after the face returns forward.

bramblin.review: Lower front twig below the floating eyes. Beam starts after the roll has settled; no casting through the rotating branch cage.

cubone.review: Reviewed lower skull muzzle. Reduced Mud-Slap size and arc leave the skull visible at release.

darkrai-mega.review: Lower face below the white crest, independently measured for this form. Special-attack beam exits forward; crest can hide the early charge from the rear.

diglett.review: Front surface below the nose; late special-attack release reuses the reviewed sludge window. This is a surface casting point, not an exposed mouth cavity.

diglett-alola.review: Own front surface below the nose; late special-attack release. Hair and rock base are excluded.

dugtrio.review: Single foreground head for generic casting and Mud-Slap; physical release after the forward bow. Existing explicit multi-head sound routes stay intact.

dugtrio-alola.review: Own foreground head, with hair clear of the late physical release. Existing multi-head sound choices are retained.

glimmora-mega.review: Long front central spike tip, ahead of the flower petals; narrow special-attack beam follows the tip.

golisopod.review: Front face between antenna roots. Special beam clears the opening as the arms spread. Bug Bite uses the face route; precise target contact spacing remains outside this approval.

golisopod-mega.review: Own purple front face point; beam follows it below the upper appendages. Upper claws and possible arm nozzles are not certified here.

magnemite.review: Central eye; narrow beam uses the already reviewed special clip and stays between the magnets during release.

magneton.review: Three eye points remain separate. Volt Switch emits three beams and Screech uses three sound sources; front views distinguish these from the magnets.

magnezone.review: Central red lens. Physical clip keeps the lens facing the target; generic beams use its existing reviewed timing.

mimikyu.review: True-body casting surface below the costume head, not the painted Pikachu mouth. Beam and reduced Shadow Ball use this point.

mimikyu-busted.review: Independently reviewed true-body casting surface; native special clip lifts the costume head temporarily. Reduced Shadow Ball and beam remain below it.

necrozma.review: Front prism below the colored eyes. Rejected special clip turns the front away; physical clip exposes the prism during the main beam window. Sweeping arms can occlude early windup.

nosepass.review: Nose tip casting surface. Reduced Mud-Slap forms in front of the tip, not above the stone head.

poltchageist.review: Generic beams use the extended spoon tip; dedicated Shadow Ball uses the spirit spiral above the pot. The reduced effects follow the separate native surfaces.

regice.review: Face-dot center. Reduced Mud-Slap uses the exposed front panel while arms move to either side.

regieleki.review: Face-dot center with reduced beam width. Native electrical arm strands can cross the viewing line; this approves the origin, not all strand clearance.

regigigas.review: Center of the yellow face strip, not either shoulder gem. Reduced Mud-Slap remains attached during the forward lean.

regirock.review: Face-dot panel between the shoulder rocks. Reduced Mud-Slap stays on the front surface.

registeel.review: Face-dot center on the dark front panel. Reduced Mud-Slap follows it while the hands lift nearby.

sandy-shocks.review: Upper central eye selected as one source. Physical clip exposes the eye; rejected special clip moved the magnets across the beam path.

scovillain-mega.review: Own red mouth for generic beams and Flamethrower using physical_attack; Solar Beam explicitly uses the green mouth and special_attack. Narrow effects remain within the respective open lips.

voltorb.review: Front seam below the eyes as a casting surface. Narrow generic beam follows the forward-facing special clip.

voltorb-hisui.review: Own front seam surface; physical clip and later .43 release avoid casting during the downward roll.

wo-chien.review: Front leaf cluster beneath the eyestalks as a casting surface, not an oral cavity. Narrow beam follows the lowered face.

wugtrio.review: Reviewed three muzzle points; Mud-Slap presenter uses the primary source. Smaller projectile and lower arc expose the head at release; this does not certify three-projectile choreography.
